Dear Bellerose team,

I'm writing to apply for the temporary CRM & Growth Marketing Specialist role. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and web, I'm drawn to Bellerose's blend of tradition and forward-thinking, and I'd love to contribute to your CRM and growth initiatives.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I work with data daily—analysing performance in Google Analytics and Search Console, running A/B tests, and translating insights into actions. I've built and optimized websites and email campaigns, managed CMS content, and used segmentation to improve retention. I'm organized, proactive, and comfortable collaborating across teams, having worked with clients in e-commerce and retail. I'm excited by the opportunity to support your loyalty program and customer journeys.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with Bellerose's needs.

Warm regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Bellerose team,

I'm excited to apply for the temporary CRM & Growth Marketing Specialist position. Bellerose's unique blend of tradition and forward-thinking, with its strong online presence and international reach, resonates with me. I'm eager to bring my digital marketing experience to your dynamic team and contribute to your CRM and growth initiatives.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I work at the intersection of SEO, content, and web. I've managed email campaigns, automations, and customer journeys for client websites, using data from Google Analytics and Search Console to identify growth opportunities and optimize performance. For example, I've implemented audience segmentation and A/B testing to improve engagement and retention. My technical background allows me to leverage AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, ensuring efficiency and accuracy.

I've collaborated closely with cross-functional teams, including content, e-commerce, and paid media, to align CRM efforts with broader marketing goals. At Knowledge Experts, I supported the development of digital workplace sites for major retailers, gaining insight into retail operations and customer behavior. I'm organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, and I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can manage multiple projects simultaneously.

An interest in fashion and e-commerce is a plus, and I've always been drawn to brands that prioritize creativity and innovation. Bellerose's commitment to giving people room to grow aligns with my own values, and I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to your loyalty program and customer retention strategies.

I'd love the chance to discuss how my skills and personality align with Bellerose's spirit and needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Experience in digital marketing with a focus on SEO, content, and web, including email campaigns and automations for client websites.
• Proficient in Google Analytics, Search Console, and A/B testing to analyze CRM performance and identify growth opportunities.
• Skilled in audience segmentation and customer retention initiatives, with a data-driven approach to marketing.
• Collaborative team player with experience working across content, e-commerce, and paid media teams.
• Technical background enables automation and efficient management of multiple projects, with a proactive and detail-oriented mindset.
